questions.question_text:
Which of the following statements about the Vaikom Satyagraha are correct?
(i) It began in 1924.
(ii) It was led only by Sree Narayana Guru.
(iii) It demanded the right to use the roads near the Vaikom temple.
questions.subject: History
questions.explanation: The satyagraha began in **1924** and demanded access to the public roads around the temple. Many leaders took part, including T.K. Madhavan and K. Kelappan, so (ii) is wrong.
